related.title: Chaos Mesh：可控制的故障範圍與停止條件
related.titleEn: Chaos Mesh: controlled fault scope and stop conditions
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 occupancy.csv、隔艙前後事件與平均/尾端界限。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver occupancy.csv,bulkhead event comparisons and average/tail limitations.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 逐Pod求namespace與label交集，先列3個候選id，再選1個確定id；程序只改記憶體事件，不連線叢集。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Evaluate namespace and label intersections,print three candidate IDs and choose one deterministic target;the program only changes in-memory events. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 20*0.2 = 4 concurrent-requests；對照 20*0.8 = 16 concurrent-requests。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
以arrival/departure事件積分area_under_concurrency，再除視窗時間，與λW交叉核對；保留暖機與未完成邊界。

基準 3/20*100 = 15 percent-of-inventory；對照 1/20*100 = 5 percent-of-inventory。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐Pod求namespace與label交集，先列3個候選id，再選1個確定id；程序只改記憶體事件，不連線叢集。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 20*0.2 = 4 concurrent-requests; comparison 20*0.8 = 16 concurrent-requests. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Integrate concurrency from arrival/departure events and divide by time,then compare withλW,accounting for warmup and unfinished requests.

Baseline 3/20*100 = 15 percent-of-inventory; comparison 1/20*100 = 5 percent-of-inventory. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Evaluate namespace and label intersections,print three candidate IDs and choose one deterministic target;the program only changes in-memory events.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
